# LeadsPlease Data API

> The official LeadsPlease REST/JSON Data API. Programmatic access to 210M+ USPS-verified U.S. consumers, 18M+ verified businesses, plus daily-loaded New Homeowner and New Mover feeds. Bearer-token (JWT) auth. OpenAPI 3.0. Polygon, radial, and ZIP/city/county/state geo selection. 30+ demographic filters. Async list generation with signed CSV downloads. Lists Aggregation API for merging multiple lists. Subscriptions API for periodic deliveries of newly loaded New Mover / New Homeowner records.

## Base URLs
- TEST: https://api-test.leadsplease.com/api/v1
- LIVE: https://api.leadsplease.com/api/v1

## Spec
- Swagger UI (TEST): https://api-test.leadsplease.com/swagger-ui/index.html
- Swagger UI (LIVE): https://api.leadsplease.com/swagger-ui/index.html

## Core endpoints
- POST /auth — exchange username/password for a 20-minute JWT
- POST /search-criteria — define list type + geos + demographics; returns criteriaId
- POST /counts — count records matching a criteriaId; rate-limited 10/min
- POST /lists — async create CSV; returns status URL
- GET  /lists/{id} — poll status; once Completed includes a signed downloadUrl
- POST /list-aggregations — merge multiple lists into one CSV
- GET  /demographic-categories?type={listType}&affiliateCode={code} — full demographic catalog
- GET  /sic-codes/search?description={kw} — SIC code lookup by description (no auth)
- POST /subscriptions — periodic delivery of newly loaded records (New Mover + New Homeowner only)

## List types
- consumer (210M+ households, 30+ demographics)
- business (18M+ verified businesses; SIC, NAICS, employee count, sales volume, executive titles)
- newhomeowner (people who closed on a home; daily loads)
- newmover (people who relocated; daily loads)

## Geo selection (geoCriteriaType)
- manual — array of zip / city / county / state
- radial — lat/lng + radiusInMiles
- polygon — array of lat/lng vertices

## Contact data points
direct_mail (always included), email, phone — toggle per criteria via contactDataPoints

## Authentication
Authorization: Bearer <token>; tokens valid 20 minutes; re-call /auth to refresh

## Pricing
- Free: TEST access, 1,000 counts/mo, 10 lists/mo, all 4 list types
- Builder: $199/mo, LIVE access, 50K counts/mo, unlimited lists, Subscriptions, 99.9% SLA
- Scale: custom (white-label, dedicated infra, Slack on-call)
